title: Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset - 421 Days

citation.text: Koexai Srl (2025). Synthetic Supernova Light Curves Dataset - 421 Days (Version 1.0.0). Koexai Srl.

abstract: This dataset contains synthetic light curves generated using semi-analytical models for supernova research. Each light curve consists of 421 daily flux measurements covering 421 consecutive days of supernova evolution. The dataset includes four corresponding physical parameters for each simulated supernova: progenitor radius, mass, explosion energy, and nickel-56 percentage. The synthetic data is designed to support machine learning applications in supernova classification and parameter estimation studies with daily cadence observations.
purpose: Supporting machine learning research in supernova classification and physical parameter estimation with daily cadence data

provenance.processing: Daily temporal sampling over 421-day observation period
provenance.derivations: Four core physical parameters derived from progenitor models

structure.conventions: Time in days from explosion start (day 1 to day 421); flux values in arbitrary units; missing values coded as NaN
structure.relationships: light_curves.parquet and params.parquet linked by implicit row index

quality.validation: Model consistency checks applied; parameter ranges validated against physical constraints
limitations: Semi-analytical models may not capture all physical complexity
Parameter space limited to four core progenitor properties
No observational noise included in synthetic data
Daily sampling may miss rapid variability features
quality.usageGuidance: Suitable for algorithm development with daily cadence data; not recommended for direct comparison with observational data without noise modeling
